## Validation

- [ ] Self-contained entry point; no app bundle/dependencies included
- [ ] Generated package and catalog SHA-256 match source
- [ ] Settings page, enable/disable, uninstall and update checked
- [ ] Cleanup verified for listeners, timers, DOM and patches
- [ ] Desktop, web/mobile fallback, offline/failure behavior checked
- [ ] Light/dark, keyboard focus and touch targets checked
- [ ] No credentials or personal data in source/package
